paragraphs: Rav Tavyomi, in Abaye's name: Bava Metzia 54b; Kiddushin 14b. In Rava's name: Bava Kamma 41b, near the end. This is not Mar son of Rav Ashi, for Abaye died before Rava, and Rav Ashi was born on the day Rava died; alternatively, he heard a report in Abaye's and Rava's names. Rav Tavyomi asked R. Chizkiyah: Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 2, mishnah 1. See the entry on Chizkiyah for his reports in Abaye’s name; thus this is Rav Tavyomi who spoke in Abaye's name.
